inputs.source_scope: Comprehensive Lake Powell / Glen Canyon Dam operational knowledge base: governing operating plans and Records of Decision, near-term and long-term operations, drought response and contingency agreements, EIS and technical appendices, infrastructure and hydropower constraints, storage/sedimentation, hydrology and CRSS modeling, and directly operational environmental requirements. Real deep source discovery targeting broad, well-justified coverage (50-60+ sources) across official USBR/EIS/technical-appendix documents and relevant peer-reviewed/technical research.

notes: Created by run-orchestration bootstrap. Stages 1-3 (source acquisition, evidence extraction, knowledge consolidation) were completed in an earlier session. This session completed Stage 4 (synthesis: 15 Synthesis Cards spanning all six primary patterns, each traced to specific EU/KC IDs and, for 7 cards, verified against rereads of the original source text), Stage 5 (indexing: 538 encoded knowledge records plus an 8-question manual retrieval benchmark run through the deterministic lexical baseline), and Stage 6 (report generation: a 10-section case-study report plus a 30-row claim-evidence map), then ran cross-stage validation and the run-contract check to a clean pass (0 errors). One pre-existing manifest inconsistency in 02_evidence_extraction/stage_manifest.json (a reproducible, already-cleaned-up intermediate listed as a required input) was corrected to required=false during this session's run-contract check; all other Stage 1-3 artifacts were left untouched.
